portal_set_truth.definition: One current-view pedestrian glass-door bank, paired-handle entrance, or open glass-door aperture. Adjacent leaves and fixed panels form one functional portal set.
portal_set_truth.membership_rule: Candidate center is inside the frozen portal-set region and at least half of candidate area lies inside it.

2.kind: Inland Revenue Centre open and closed glass door bank

4.kind: Cheng Yu Tung Building glass door bank

6.kind: Cheung Lee paired open glass doors

frame_audit.1: Wide multi-leaf glass entrance with repeated handles.
frame_audit.2: Open left leaf plus closed right glass-door bank at the named revenue centre.
frame_audit.3: Framed glass entrance assembly with a nested lobby doorway.
frame_audit.4: Two open glass leaves and fixed panels at the named teaching building.
frame_audit.5: Foreground glass entrance plane with repeated vertical handles.
frame_audit.6: Paired open glass doors with large symmetric handles.

fresh_gate: Unchanged dual-family v3 top-3 portal-set membership must be at least 4/6. Run once without tuning.
claim_boundary: This authority covers current-image functional glass-entrance membership only; not requested-entity identity, public access, traversability, temporal tracking, guidance, arrival, benefit, or safety.
